entries.reasoning: Gulf Crown Hotels & Resorts Co. is a Hospitality Business as defined in §1.11. The Services provided, including the Revenue Management Module and Guest Analytics Module, fall under data analytics and revenue management services. The work will be performed in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, which is part of the GCC. The services are directly provided to a Hospitality Business in the GCC, thus triggering the restriction in Clause 12.1 of the Al Noor Hospitality Group MSA.
readings: The Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC

entries.suggestedChange: Comply with the restriction by ensuring that AtliQ Pvt Ltd does not provide the specified services to Gulf Crown Hotels & Resorts Co. during the Restricted Period. Seek consent from Al Noor Hospitality Group LLC for any exceptions or to obtain a waiver if necessary.
entries.waiverWhy: The waiver provided by Al Noor Hospitality Group LLC is limited to Seaside Hotels LLC, Muscat, Oman, and does not cover services to Gulf Crown Hotels & Resorts Co. in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
entries.impact: This restriction could impact the scope of services AtliQ Pvt Ltd can provide under the new contract. Compliance may require additional negotiations or obtaining a new waiver.

entries.reasoning: The Services provided under the new contract, including the Revenue Management Module and Guest Analytics Module, are data analytics and revenue management services. However, the applicability of the most-favoured nation (MFN) pricing clause is not entirely clear. The services are being provided to a single client in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, which is not necessarily a 'substantially similar service' to those provided to other clients as defined in §1.1. The clause may not apply as the services are not being offered to 'any other customer' in the GCC.
